[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Janson Edgewood''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
In about [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Commander Janson Edgewood briefly stayed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while on a mission for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] there, he witnessed operatives of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jor Idrall]] brawling with some locals. Janson and the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under his command, dressed in civilian garb, intervened to restore order. The brawl was a warning from Idrall directed at [[Spy/Legends|spies]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] crime lord [[Rethorn]]; the message being that Tatooine was Idrall's turf and it was protected. Edgewood later reported this incident to the Republic.
